description:
Brand Introduction: Raakenar is a unique online store specializing in high-quality, personalizable gifts that cater to every occasion. We offer a wide range of customizable products, including t-shirts, mugs, phone cases, and canvas prints, allowing customers to add their personal touch to their gifts. Whether it's for a birthday, wedding, or any special event, Raakenar ensures that every gift is as unique as the person receiving it.

Product Description: Raakenar offers an extensive selection of personalizable gifts, each crafted with care and attention to detail. Our products include:

  • Custom T-shirts: Choose from a variety of designs, add a personal message, and create the perfect wearable gift.
  • Personalized Mugs: A delightful gift for coffee lovers, featuring custom messages, names, or artwork.
  • Custom Phone Cases: Protect your phone in style with a unique, one-of-a-kind design.
  • Canvas Prints: Transform favorite photos or artwork into beautiful canvas prints that make lasting memories.

Each product is made with high-quality materials, ensuring both durability and aesthetic appeal.

USP (Unique Selling Point): Raakenar’s unique selling point lies in the ability to create truly personalized gifts that carry sentimental value. Our easy-to-use customization process makes it simple for customers to design products that perfectly reflect their personal style or message. With a focus on high-quality, durable materials and excellent customer service, Raakenar stands out in the crowded personal gift market.

Payment Terms:

  • Commission Rate: Earn competitive commissions for every sale made through your affiliate link.
  • Minimum Payout: Payments made via PayPal or bank transfer (depending on your preference).
  • Cookie Duration: 30-day cookie tracking ensures you get credit for any purchase made within a month of clicking your referral link.

Other Information:

  • Customer Support: Our dedicated affiliate support team is available to assist with any questions or issues you may have.
  • Exclusive Offers: Affiliates will have access to special promotions and discounts that can be used to boost sales.

Join the Raakenar Affiliate Program today and start earning by sharing our personalizable gifts with your audience!
